prompts.name: ghibli-night-tram
prompts.prompt: Create one finished desktop wallpaper, landscape 16:9, ideally 3840x2160. Full bleed, a single image, no collage, no border, no text, no watermark, no logos. For a productivity desktop: calm composition, spacious areas, restrained highlights and detail, beautiful at full screen. No natural scenery, no plants, no forests, no mountains, no ocean, no countryside. Use case: illustration-story. A Studio Ghibli-inspired hand-painted animation background of the inside of an empty old city tram late at night. Worn wooden fittings, upholstered benches, overhead hand straps, softly glowing interior lamps, urban building windows visible beyond the tram windows. Warm intimate lighting, painterly gouache textures, carefully drawn perspective, quiet everyday atmosphere. Wide cinematic view along the carriage, no characters, interior and city architecture only.

prompts.name: ghibli-old-cinema
prompts.prompt: Create one finished desktop wallpaper, landscape 16:9, ideally 3840x2160. Full bleed, a single image, no collage, no border, no text, no watermark, no logos. For a productivity desktop: calm composition, spacious areas, restrained highlights and detail, beautiful at full screen. No natural scenery, no plants, no forests, no mountains, no ocean, no countryside. Use case: illustration-story. A Studio Ghibli-inspired hand-painted animation background of a small old neighborhood cinema auditorium after closing. Rows of gently worn upholstered seats, a blank softly dim cinema screen, velvet curtains, wall sconces, a projection booth window. Charming lived-in architectural details, expressive hand-painted gouache texture, subdued cozy lighting, wide view from the back, no people, entirely indoors. The screen must not be glaring white; keep the whole image comfortable and softly lit.

prompts.name: retro-scifi-workshop
prompts.prompt: Create one finished desktop wallpaper, landscape 16:9, ideally 3840x2160. Full bleed, a single image, no collage, no border, no text, no watermark, no logos. For a productivity desktop: calm composition, spacious areas, restrained highlights and detail, beautiful at full screen. No natural scenery, no plants, no forests, no mountains, no ocean, no countryside. Use case: stylized-concept. Retro-futurist analog science fiction workshop interior rendered as a sophisticated cinematic 3D scene. Built-in workstation with chunky CRT monitors showing only soft abstract glows, modular industrial wall panels, mechanical controls, a swivel chair, carefully routed cables. Strong architectural composition, matte aged materials, subtle film grain, subdued ambient lighting and small practical light sources, believable detailed model construction. No people, no exterior landscape, no readable interface text. Quiet, spacious, tasteful, not busy cyberpunk.

prompts.name: geometric-relief
prompts.prompt: Create one finished desktop wallpaper, landscape 16:9, ideally 3840x2160. Full bleed, a single image, no collage, no border, no text, no watermark, no logos. For a productivity desktop: calm composition, spacious areas, restrained highlights and detail, beautiful at full screen. No natural scenery, no plants, no forests, no mountains, no ocean, no countryside. Use case: stylized-concept. An elegant abstract geometric desktop wallpaper, Bauhaus-inspired composition rendered as tactile matte sculptural relief. A few large intersecting circles, arches and rectangular planes with precise spacing, subtle paper and plaster texture, gentle directional shadows and depth. Calm asymmetrical balance with ample uninterrupted areas, muted earthy colors with dark accents, no white background, no objects or scenery, no typography. Sophisticated restrained gallery-quality geometric abstraction, radically different from illustration or science fiction.

prompts.name: anime-coastal-platform
prompts.prompt: Create a finished original 2D Japanese animation-background-inspired desktop wallpaper: an empty small coastal railway platform at early summer dawn, beside a calm turquoise sea under pale mist. A simple bench and utility poles stay on the right third; low coastal grasses only at the far edges. Muted teal, sea-glass green and blue-gray; delicate ink contours, matte watercolor and gouache fields, restrained cel shading. Landscape 16:9, full bleed, broad quiet sea and sky through the centre, crop-safe at 16:10 and ultrawide. No people, text, logos, watermark, UI, photorealism, 3D rendering, glare, border or collage.

prompts.name: anime-maple-veranda
prompts.prompt: Create a finished original 2D Japanese animation-background-inspired desktop wallpaper viewed from a wooden veranda in late autumn afternoon. Deep warm timber framing at the sides, a restrained maple garden with orange-red leaves, olive foliage and distant soft mountains. Visible pencil and ink contours, limited cel-shaded forms, matte watercolor and gouache texture. Landscape 16:9, full bleed; keep the central veranda floor, sky and garden opening broad and simple, crop-safe at 16:10 and ultrawide. No people, writing, logos, watermark, UI, photorealism, 3D rendering, dense leaves, glare, border or collage.

prompts.name: modern-prismatic-glass
prompts.prompt: Create a finished modern abstract desktop wallpaper: large translucent frosted-glass planes overlap a deep navy field, with blurred prismatic reflections, soft chromatic refractions, subtle depth and minute film grain. Landscape 16:9, full bleed; only a few large forms clustered toward the edges, with a calm uninterrupted central field, crop-safe at 16:10 and ultrawide. Ink navy, smoky indigo, desaturated cyan, restrained lavender and muted amber. No text, logos, watermark, UI, objects, neon cyberpunk, busy facets, pure-black void, border or collage.

prompts.name: modern-mineral-flow
prompts.prompt: Create a finished modern abstract desktop wallpaper: warm gray mineral stone is crossed by one or two broad flowing satin-metal curves with restrained cobalt and vermilion lacquer planes. Contemporary gallery-installation material art with precise large forms and elegant long soft shadows. Landscape 16:9, full bleed; broad quiet central areas, crop-safe at 16:10 and ultrawide. No text, logos, watermark, UI, figures, buildings, plants, clutter, extreme reflections, busy tessellation, glare, border or collage.
